operating_notes.text: Consolidated pay channel cost was ₹335.91 Cr in Q2FY27, up from ₹280.03 Cr a year earlier.
The group contests a ₹3,201.93 Cr DoT licence-fee demand (standalone ₹3,160.63 Cr) and has made no provision.
Hathway Channel 5 Cable and Datacom Private Limited moved from joint venture to subsidiary from April 13, 2026.

timeline.summary: Akshay Raheja, Viren Raheja, Hathway Investments Private Limited, Globus Stores Private Limited declared no encumbrance on Hathway Cable & Datacom shares as of March 31, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹567.51 Cr (+5.7% YoY), net profit ₹10.16 Cr (-44.3% YoY).
